authority_source: meta authority for valid discovery P1/P2 remediation strictly inside R5 and the R3 MAC corridor
classification: bounded remediation of the seven valid R5 discovery findings; no new packet, transport, platform, protected-state field, or R6 behavior

trusted_bootstrap_provenance.installation: The MAC branch of dev-install-substrate.sh writes an absent-or-exact root:wheel 0600 canonical record only after both fixed MAC binaries and their managed-copy manifest are durable. It records source commit/tree/ref, reviewed R5 review-record digest, control/executor target triples, digests, no-follow physical identities and code-designated requirements, plus the canonical pre-PM manifest identity and IH commitment. Parent and file are opened no-follow and fsynced; mismatch blocks and is never overwritten or adopted.
trusted_bootstrap_provenance.runtime: The hidden direct command treats stdin only as a requested seed. Before deriving authorization it opens the fixed provenance record and both installed binaries no-follow, verifies root ownership/mode/parent identity, recomputes record digest, image digests/physical/code identities and source/review/manifest joins, and rejects any seed value not exactly equal to retained provenance. The seed never becomes authority.

fd3_peer_and_frame.rule: Before decoding any FD3 authorization bytes, derive the kernel peer PID, resolve the peer executable, open it O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC, fstat/hash through the descriptor, re-observe the peer path/identity, and compare digest/physical/code identity to the already retained provenance/control authority. The decoded frame may only further constrain that authority.
fd3_peer_and_frame.timeout: Apply a fixed bounded timeout to the initial FD3 frame read and to the single bounded response/EOF proof. Timeout, EOF, extra frame, peer exit, path/identity change, or mismatch preserves state and fails.

global_control_admission.rule: Store this canonical record in the fixed global System-Keychain admission account instead of a bare control authority. Listener startup and every XPC admission must load the current protected state and exact-join the admission record, authorization/manifest identity, current signed anchor and measured peer before request decode. Update it only in the same preserving CAS transition as anchor advancement; mismatch blocks.

stage_one_successor_manifest.carrier: Extend the signed LimaStageOneAuthorizationV1 itself—not the generic request/tag/argv/environment—with one canonical next_pm_manifest, expected_pre_pm_anchor_sha256/counter, and the exact planned Stage-1 receipt identity. The existing lifecycle signature covers every byte.
joins: next manifest is mac_host_shared/mac_lima, generation exactly current+1, previous_manifest_sha256 equals current pre-PM digest
IH/scope/principal/source/executor/attempt exact-join Stage-1 authorization and current anchor
PM commitment/control-root/instance/machine identity are derived from the observed created instance and must exact-match the signed manifest projection before publication
no post-PM or guest action is accepted until the full manifest, empty index/head, action receipt/index/head, next signed anchor, protected state and admission record are durable and exact-joined
stage_one_successor_manifest.transaction: Use the existing ManagedActionPreparedRecordV1, ManagedActionReceiptV1, receipt-index/head helpers and protected-state CAS. Remove the overwriteable last-action-receipt shortcut. Allocate the receipt before effect, preserve ambiguity on kill/failure, publish the signed authoritative receipt after durable observation, advance index/head, sign the next anchor, CAS protected state/admission, and return only the durable receipt observation.
stage_one_successor_manifest.retry: Exact matching prepared/receipt/index/head/anchor/admission state resumes; missing or mismatched state blocks without replacement.

ordinary_request_remediation.closed_shape: Both ordinary tags reject every legacy manifest, protected-state, action-receipt, pairing-ticket, bootstrap-authorization and unknown field not explicitly required by that tag.
ordinary_request_remediation.joins: Recompute and exact-join IH carrier, PM carrier, scope, principal, control root, instance/machine identity, source/build evidence, current anchor, manifest generation/digest and role/action before XPC/effect. Stage-1 remains absent-instance-create only; post-PM remains the closed table only.
ordinary_request_remediation.receipt: Every ordinary action uses the same authoritative prepared/receipt/index/head/anchor CAS path; no fixed overwriteable receipt is authoritative.

path_expansion_reason: Only the MAC installer branch can create the fixed root-owned provenance trust root before first publisher bootstrap; its existing Bash 3.2/retry regression is the bounded fixture for that behavior.
required_tests: fabricated/self-consistent direct seeds reject unless every value exact-joins the root-owned provenance record and measured binaries
provenance absent/create/exact-retry, parent/file symlink, owner/mode, read/hash/fsync, partial binary/record publication and mismatch preservation
FD3 peer PID/path replacement, no-follow identity/digest/code-requirement mismatch and initial/read/response/EOF timeout/extra-frame negatives
admission record absent/mismatch/anchor rollback/manifest mismatch/state revision and listener-before-decode negatives
Stage-1 signed next-manifest field/PM/source/scope/principal/anchor/receipt joins and every kill/retry boundary
authoritative prepared receipt -> effect -> receipt file -> index -> head -> signed anchor -> protected-state/admission CAS ordering
both ordinary tags reject legacy/unknown/cross-tag fields and every cross-IH/PM/principal/control-root/machine/source/build/anchor/manifest pair
existing R5 role/action, descriptor preservation, pre-PM, image, TTY and no-generic-selector tests remain

review.next_cycle_after_remediation: closure-1 with a different fresh reviewer on the new frozen subject
review.supplemental_rule: only P1/P2 directly caused or unmasked by the immediately preceding remediation

hard_exclusions: generic request, generic selector, caller path, caller provenance record, ambient project/Git/remote authority, second FD3 frame, or new transport/endpoint/session
R6 ticket/data/TTY session implementation or guest pairing behavior
Linux/Windows source, constructors, target commands, behavior, or platform proof
native install, code signing, Keychain/XPC/Lima mutation, lifecycle action, or evidence action in this implementation task
any implementation/test path beyond the exact fifteen-path list
reset, clean, rebase, donor bulk-copy, commit or publication before terminal CLEAN
publication: one normal fast-forward R5 commit only after all discovery P1/P2 findings are remediated, MAC-only deterministic proof passes, and closure/supplemental review terminates CLEAN
